roles.title: Associate Product Manager – AI & Voice Technology

bullets: Support day-to-day product operations, including ticket management, requirements gathering, specifications, backlog organization, testing, product releases, and documentation.
Collaborate with Product Leaders to gather business requirements and translate them into clear product specifications and actionable development tasks.
Coordinate with development teams, sales teams, and other business stakeholders to ensure effective execution of product updates and initiatives.
Review call recordings and conversation transcripts to identify AI performance issues, conversational breakdowns, customer experience challenges, and opportunities for…
Analyze customer and internal user experiences to identify friction points and recommend practical improvements to product functionality and usability.
